name: Pope Alexander III
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1159 to 1181
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 7 September 1159 until his death in 1181.

checks.lead: Pope Alexander III (c. 1100/1105 – 30 August 1181), born Roland (Italian: Rolando), was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 7 September 1159 until his death in 1181.
